# ApexLogics — EdTech & CareerTech Intelligence Suite
# https://apexlogics.org
# Publisher: Apex Advisors — https://apexadvisory.site

# AP2 Protocol: google_agent_purchase_protocol_sep_2025
# Suite version: registry v4.5.0 · spec v10.1 · contract v1.5.3
# Last updated: 2026-06-03
# Tools: 62 shipped · 0 deferred · 0 proposed
# Privacy: Zero PII. All computation client-side. No accounts, no tracking.

## Summary

ApexLogics is a suite of 62 deterministic, browser-based decision engines for career and education economics: credential ROI, education financing, compensation analysis, career transitions, licensing, workforce development, and immigration. Every tool is a single self-contained HTML file with zero network calls after load and zero PII collection. All tools emit AP2 mandates (JSON) and Markdown reports for agent and human handoff. 18 multi-tool workflows chain tools into end-to-end decision journeys at /workflows/. 7 persona guides at /guides/.

## How to Use This File

Each tool entry below gives: display number, AL-ID, title, URL, one-line description, AP2 mandate type emitted, and downstream handoff candidates. Full machine-readable metadata (tags, personas, journeys, data vintage): https://apexlogics.org/suite-registry.json

## Category: Education Path & ROI (24 tools)

### #01 · AL-02 — Credential ROI Suite
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/01-credential-roi-suite/
Calculate the NPV and payback period of professional certifications against career earnings uplift.
AP2 mandate type: credential_roi_evaluation
Handoffs out: AL-26

### #56 · AL-63 — MBA Scholarship Strategy Engine
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/56-mba-scholarship-strategy-engine/
Two-stage scholarship strategy engine: (1) Round Timing Optimizer — dollar EV of applying R1 vs. R2 vs. R3 given application readiness, admit-rate edge, and merit budget depletion; (2) Offer Negotiation EV — probability-weighted value of countering with a competing offer, by school type.
AP2 mandate type: mba_scholarship_record
Handoffs out: AL-52, AL-26, AL-29, AL-13

### #57 · AL-64 — MBA Admissions Consulting ROI Calculator
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/57-mba-admissions-consulting-roi/
Expected-value model for admissions consulting: converts claimed admission-probability uplift into dollar EV using tier salary premium NPVs, computes break-even uplift for the fee, and runs sensitivity across 2–15pp real uplift.
AP2 mandate type: consulting_roi_record
Handoffs out: AL-52, AL-63, AL-26, AL-29

### #58 · AL-65 — MBA Yield Decision Engine
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/58-mba-yield-decision-engine/

URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/59-dual-degree-roi-calculator/
Three-path NPV model for JD/MBA, MD/MBA, MPH/MBA, MPP/MBA decisions: primary degree only vs. concurrent dual vs. sequential. Computes dual marginal cost, cross-domain salary premium, break-even year, and concurrency savings.
AP2 mandate type: dual_degree_record

### #60 · AL-67 — Online MBA vs. EMBA vs. Full-Time MBA 4-Path Comparator
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/60-online-mba-comparator/
Four-path NPV and goal-fit comparator: Online MBA, EMBA, Full-Time MBA, No MBA. Models income continuity, employer perception multipliers (GMAC 2025 ~90% online acceptance), salary reset vs. uplift mechanics, and pivot feasibility by career goal.
AP2 mandate type: online_mba_record
Handoffs out: AL-57, AL-26, AL-48, AL-13

### #61 · AL-68 — MBA Waitlist Expected Value Engine
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/61-mba-waitlist-ev-engine/
Three-option EV model for waitlisted MBA applicants: stay on list (hedged with safety deposit), withdraw and commit, or gap-year and reapply. Uses school-class yield rates to estimate P(off waitlist) and tier premium NPVs for upgrade value.
AP2 mandate type: mba_waitlist_record
Handoffs out: AL-65, AL-63, AL-52, AL-69

### #62 · AL-69 — Deferred Enrollment MBA Decision Engine
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/62-deferred-enrollment-mba-engine/
Option-value model for deferred MBA admits: accept a guaranteed seat now vs. decline and reapply to a higher tier later. Computes risk-adjusted EVs, break-even upgrade probability, and the dollar value of the guarantee.
AP2 mandate type: deferred_mba_record
Handoffs out: AL-52, AL-68, AL-26, AL-43

### #36 · AL-41 — Workforce Pell Eligibility Screener
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/36-workforce-pell-eligibility-screener/
Estimates Workforce Pell Grant award for short-term credential programs (150-599 clock hours, 8-14 weeks) under OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (effective July 1, 2026). Inputs: AGI or SAI, family size, dependency status, clock hours, weeks, occupation category. Outputs: estimated SAI, base Pell eligibility, proration ratio, award, lifetime usage note.
AP2 mandate type: workforce_pell_record
Handoffs out: AL-02, AL-01

### #37 · AL-42 — Workforce Pell Credential Value Ranker
URL: https://apexlogics.org/tools/37-workforce-pell-credential-ranker/

AP2 mandate type: workforce_pell_credential_rank
Handoffs out: AL-41, AL-01

Note: the suite spans two AP2 schema generations — v1.0 (nested mandates, tools #01–#33-era) and v2.0 (flat mandates, tools #29+). Canonical reconciliation lives in the build contract; each tool validates its emitted type before download.

## Technical Constraints (All Tools)

- Single self-contained .html file per tool. No external dependencies post-load.
- Zero network calls. No fetch, XHR, WebWorker, or CDN after page load.
- Zero PII. No storage, logging, or transmission of personal data.
- sessionStorage: apex_lang key only (UI language preference).
- Fonts: Google Fonts (DM Serif Display, Sora, JetBrains Mono) loaded at page open only.
- i18n: EN/ES/FR/AR/PT/Chinese language toggle on every tool.
- AP2 export: JSON + Markdown download. Schema validation runs before any download.
- PII banner: "All inputs are processed locally in your browser. Nothing is transmitted, stored, or logged."
- License: CC BY 4.0. Source readable and attribution-ready.
